annotations.title: FDIC bank lookup for up to 10 banks

description: FDIC bank lookup for up to 10 banks — Look up to 10 FDIC-insured banks at once by certificate number or name (separated by ;): name, city/state, active and insured status, charter, regulator, total assets and deposits, YTD net income, ROA/ROE, offices, plus combined assets, largest/smallest, highest/lowest ROA, flags (inactive, loss-making) and ambiguous-name warnings. Source: FDIC BankFind Suite (public domain). JSON. Price: $0.03 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: finance_bank_batch
